_comment: 2025 賽季導言 facts pack。每個 verified:true 的 claim 由 scripts/check-season-intros.py 內建查詢對 data/f1/db.sqlite 重查驗證；導言中每個阿拉伯數字都必須落在本檔 verified claims 的值集合內。2025 為已完結賽季（2026 進行中不算冠軍）。

claims.source: sqlite: SELECT 1 FROM seasons WHERE year=2025
sqlite: SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE season=2025

claims.text: 麥拉倫全季拿下 14 場分站冠軍
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE season=2025 AND constructor_id='mclaren' AND position_text='1'
sqlite: SELECT points FROM driver_standings WHERE season=2025 AND position=1

claims.text: 維斯塔潘年度第二，421 分
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT points FROM driver_standings WHERE season=2025 AND position=2

claims.text: 皮亞斯特里年度順位第三
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT position FROM driver_standings WHERE season=2025 AND driver_id='piastri'

claims.text: 諾里斯的冠軍在賽季最終站（倒數第 1 站）才數學鎖定
